```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r}
mv_hurr <- load_multiverse("hurricane")
mv_hurr
```

# Overview

```{r}
mv_hurr |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_hurr, direction = "right")
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r}
reg_hurr <- calc_regression(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
reg_hurr
```

```{r}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_hurr)
```

## FANOVA

```{r}
fanova_hurr <- calc_fanova(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
fanova_hurr
```

```{r}
fanova_hurr |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```


# Our Framework

```{r}
within_hurr <- calc_within_bucket_variation(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
within_hurr
```

```{r}
vis_importance(within_hurr)
```

```{r}
between_hurr <- calc_between_bucket_variation(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
between_hurr
```
